name: College of Whispers
description: A legacy bard subclass from Xanathar's Guide to Everything.

grants.name: Psychic Blades
grants.description: Once per round on your turn after hitting with a weapon attack, expend Bardic Inspiration to deal extra Psychic damage: 2d6 at Bard level 3, 3d6 at level 5, 5d6 at level 10, and 8d6 at level 15.

grants.name: Words of Terror
grants.description: After speaking alone with a Humanoid for at least 1 minute, force a Wisdom save. On a failure it is Frightened of you or a chosen creature for 1 hour, ending early when it or its allies are attacked or damaged. A successful target does not detect the attempt. Regain use after a Short or Long Rest.

grants.name: Mantle of Whispers
grants.description: When a Humanoid dies within 30 feet, use your reaction to capture its shadow until used or your next Long Rest. As an action, assume its living appearance and accessible memories for 1 hour; end it as a Bonus Action. Insight contested by your Deception, with +5 to your check, can expose the disguise. Regain capture after a Short or Long Rest.

grants.name: Shadow Lore
grants.description: As an action, whisper to one creature within 30 feet that can hear and understand you. On a failed Wisdom save it is Charmed for 8 hours and believes you know its worst secret, ending if you or allies harm it or force a save. Regain use after a Long Rest.
